s: puM, (kzArEryuktaH kzArapraDAnaH sinDurvA .) lavaRasamudraH । sa tu jambudvIpasya dakziRe SAkadvIpasya uttare varttate । yaTA, -- “BUmerardDaM kzArasinDorudakasTaM jambudvIpaM prAhurAcAryyavaryyAH । ardDe'nyasmin dvIpazawkasya yAmye kzArakzIrAdyambaDInAM niveSaH ॥ SAkaM tataH SAlmalamatra kOSaM krOYcaYca gomedakapuzkare ca । dvayordvayorantaramekamekaM samudrayordvIpamudAharanti” ॥ iti sidDAntaSiromaRO golADyAyaH ॥
m: क्षार—सिन्धु m. id.

s: klI, (kzArayutaM kzArAKyaM vA tElam .) pakvatElaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “SuzkamUlakaSuRWInAM kzAro hiNgulanAgaram । SatapuzpI vacA kuzWaM dAru Sigru rasAYjanam ॥ sOvarccalaM yavakzAraM sAmudra sEnDavantaTA । BujagranTi viqaM mustaM maDu SuklaM caturguRam ॥ mAtuluNgarasaYcEva kadalIrasameva ca । tElameBirvvipaktavyaM karRaSUlApahaM param ॥ bADiryyaM karRanAdaSca pUyasrAvaSca dAruRaH । pUraRAdasya tElasya kfmayaH karRayoH KilAH ॥ kzipraM vinASamAyAnti SaSANkakftaSeKara ! । kzAratElamidaM SrezWaM muKadantAmayApaham” ॥ iti garuqe 198 aDyAyaH ॥
v: na॰ cakra॰ ukte karRaSUlanivArake 1 pakvatElaBede yaTA “bAlamUlakaSuRWInAM kzArI hiNgu sanAgaram । SatapuzpavacAmuzkaM dAruSigrurasAYjanam । sOvarccalaM yavakzAraH sarjikodBidasEnDavam । BUrjagranTiviqaM mustaM maDuSuktaM caturguRam । mAtuluNgarasaScEva kadalyA rasa eva ca । tElameBirvipaktavyaM karRaSUlaharaM param । bADiryyaM karRanAdaSca pUyasrAvaSca dAruRaH । pUraRAdasya tElasya krimayaH karRamaMSritAH । kzipaM vinASaM gacCanti kfzRAtreyasya SAsanAt । kzAratElamidaM SrezWaM muKadantAmayApaham । maDupraDAnaM Suktantu maDuSuktaM taTozaram । jambIrasya PalarasaM pippalImUlasaMyutam । maDuBARqe vinikzipya DAnyarASO niDApayet । mAsena tajjAtarasaM maDuSuktamudAhftam” । gAruqe 1980 a॰ itTameva । tatrokte nirlomatAdisADane 2 tElaBede ca yaTA “SuktiSambU kaSaNKAnAM dIrGavfntAt samuskakAt । dagDvA kzAraM samAdAya KaramUtreRa gAlayet । kzArAzwaBAgaM vipracet tElaYca sArzapaM buDaH । idamantaHpure deyaM tElamAtrezu pUjitam । vindurekaH patedyatra tatra romApunarBavaH । madanAdivraRe deyamaSviByAYca vinirmmitam । arSasAM kuzWarogARAM pAmAdadruvicarccikAm । kzAratElamidaM SrezWaM sarvakledaharaM param .”
m: क्षार—तैल n. oil cooked with alkaline ingredients, GāruḍaP.
क्षार—तन्त्र n. the method of cauterization, Car. vi, 5.

[क्षत्रस्य कर्म भावो वा अण्] Relating or peculiar to the military tribe; क्षात्रो धर्मः श्रित इव तनुं ब्रह्मघोषस्य गुप्त्यै U. 6. 9; R. 1. 13. --त्रं 1 The Kṣatriya tribe. --2 The qualifications of a Kṣatriya; the Gītā thus describes them: --शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनं . दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजं Bg. 18. 43.
